note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Social Democratic minority government supported by the Left and Green parties), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: very strong trade unions closely linked to the Social Democrats, organised employers, a free and influential press, and a non-aligned, conscript-based military under civilian control.
